name: Hostile Bid
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach bad publicity, which no other deck gives — Hostile Takeover is the only card in the pool that does — and meat damage for Crash Space to prevent (Measured Response). Weyland Consortium: Building a Better World, an identity no sample deck uses. Eternal-legal only. Vantage Point Stage 3a: Let Them Dream for Offworld Office. Vantage Point Stage 4b: two Event Horizon for two Tithe. Stage 5a: Shackleton Grid for Regolith Mining License. Stage 7a: two Luana Campos for two PAD Campaign. Stage 7d: two Sacrifice Zone Expansion for two Off the Books, and two Myōshu for a Hedge Fund and a Measured Response. Stage 7f: two Tocsin for two Enigma, to be used from HQ for a barrier and a sentry. Stage 7g: two Flagship for two Wall of Static, for runs on HQ or R&D that are breached and not declared successful. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 4a: two Logjam for two Palisade, two Business As Usual for two Petty Cash. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 4b: two Hearts and Minds for a PAD Campaign and a Government Subsidy, and an Isaac Liberdade for a Whitespace. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 5b: two Hammer for two Kessleroid. The Automata Initiative Stage 1: two Cybersand Harvester for two Hedge Fund, and two Pivot for two Measured Response. The Automata Initiative Stage 2: two Valentão for two Ballista.
